An '''individual''' on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] gained his freedom from [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] and took the name of [[Yaru Korsin|Korsin]] as a [[Korsin|title]] for himself. He devoted his life to live like the first [[Grand Lord]], and a century [[3000 BBY|later]] many other [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] would pattern themselves after him, also taking the title of ''Korsin''.
